topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's core themes regarding cancer evolution and outlines the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Mutational and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how genetic mutations and epigenetic modifications confer competitive fitness advantages to drive clonal expansion.

topics.label: The cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: They investigate how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties influence tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependency
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how inflammatory stimuli and supportive stromal environments drive tumor development and maintenance.

topics.label: Technologies for investigating tumor evolution and microenvironment
topics.groupedBecause: It discusses single-cell sequencing and spatial omics technologies used to resolve tumor heterogeneity and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Multifactorial framework of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: It synthesizes genetic, epigenetic, cell-of-origin, and microenvironmental factors into a comprehensive model of cancer development.

topics.label: Closing remarks and next lecture preview
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
